## Load Packages
```{r, message=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
library(DT)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(showtext)
library(tidyverse)

# load google font
font_add_google(name = "Saira", family = "Saira")

# turn on showtext
showtext_auto()
```

## Connect to Database
```{r}
kanto_database <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "kanto_database.duckdb")
```

```{r}
# list all tables from database
dbListTables(kanto_database)
```

## Query Database

### Q1. How are the Kanto region Pokémon divided among growth rates, and which Pokémon have the fastest growth rate?
```{r}
# query total number of pokemon for each growth rate
q1.1_query <- dbGetQuery(kanto_database,
                         "SELECT growth_rate, COUNT(*) AS total
                         FROM training_breeding_stats
                         LEFT JOIN growth_rate
                            ON training_breeding_stats.growth_rate_id = growth_rate.growth_rate_id
                         GROUP BY growth_rate
                         ORDER BY total DESC;")
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
# pokeball palette
palette <- c("#bc1c0c", "#ee4035", "#ffffff", "#a09f9d")

# donut plot (pokeball)
q1.1_query %>%
  mutate(percent = total/sum(total),
         ymax = cumsum(percent),
         ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
         position = (ymax + ymin)/2,
         label = total) %>%
  ggplot(aes(ymax = ymax,
             ymin = ymin, 
             xmax = 4, 
             xmin = 2.5, 
             fill = growth_rate)) +
  geom_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", start = -pi/2) +
  xlim(c(2, 4)) +
  geom_text(x = 3.3, aes(y = position, label = label, color = growth_rate), 
            size = 5, 
            color = "black", 
            family = "Saira") +
  geom_text(x = 2, y = 2, label = 151, size = 5, family = "Saira") +
  geom_point(aes(x = 2, y = 1), shape = 21, size = 15, stroke = 1.5, color = "black", fill = NA) +
  labs(title = "Pokémon Growth Rates in the Kanto Region",
       subtitle = "Distribution of common growth rate types in Generation I",
       fill = "Growth Rate") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.text.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.width = unit(3, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, family = "Saira"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Saira"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", family = "Saira"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, family = "Saira"))
```

```{r}
# query pokemon with a fast growth rate descending by total base stats
q1.2_query <- dbGetQuery(kanto_database,
                         "SELECT training_breeding_stats.national_no, training_breeding_stats.pokemon,
                                 type_1, hp, attack, defense, sp_atk, sp_def, speed, total
                         FROM training_breeding_stats
                         LEFT JOIN growth_rate
                            ON training_breeding_stats.growth_rate_id = growth_rate.growth_rate_id
                         LEFT JOIN base_stats
                            ON training_breeding_stats.national_no = base_stats.national_no
                         WHERE growth_rate.growth_rate LIKE '%Fast%'
                         ORDER BY total DESC;")
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
# data table 
q1.2_query %>%
  datatable(colnames = c("National No.", "Pokémon", "Type",
                         "HP", "Attack", "Defense", "Sp. Atk",
                         "Sp. Def", "Speed", "Total"),
            class = "row-border",
            caption = "Pokémon with Fast Growth Rates Ranked by Total Base Stats",
            options = list(dom = "t", 
                           ordering = FALSE,
                           columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"))))
```

### Q2.
